title: Avengers: Doomsday is 5 weeks away, so I built hexagon README badges. What are you building?
why_read: A lighthearted novelty project generating decorative movie-themed README badges, with essentially no technical substance beyond a simple SVG badge generator.
analysis: This is a small side project that produces hexagon-shaped, Avengers-movie-themed GitHub README badges with glow effects and live GitHub stats, served as SVGs from a URL. There is no significant technical innovation here beyond basic badge generation that many existing tools already do, and the post is largely a fun community engagement prompt rather than a technical writeup. It may amuse hobbyists decorating their README files but offers nothing of substance for a professional engineering digest.
